# Car Key Duplicate NYC

> Mobile automotive locksmith that duplicates and programs car keys on-site across all five New York City boroughs (Brooklyn, Queens, Manhattan, The Bronx, Staten Island). Transponder (chip) keys, remote key fobs, smart/proximity keys, push-to-start fobs, laser-cut keys and spare keys. Lost-key (all keys lost) replacement by VIN. Service in English and Spanish.

Phone: (929) 828-7009 · Base: 75-20 Astoria Blvd, East Elmhurst, NY 11370 · Hours: Mon–Sun 9AM–5PM, 24/7 emergency dispatch.
Typical pricing (2026): spare transponder key from $95; remote key fob from $120; smart / push-to-start key from $175; laser-cut key from $150; basic spare key from $75. Final price depends on year, make, model and whether a working key exists.
